name: ARE Holdings, Inc.
summary: ARE Holdings, Inc. engages in refining, manufacturing, and trading of precious metals and rare metals in Japan, Asia, and North America. The company operates in two segments, Precious Metals and Environmental Preservation. It recycles and sells various metals, including gold, silver, palladium, platinum, and rhodium that are used in a range of industry fields, such as E-scrap, dentistry, jewelry, plating treatment, precision cleaning, and catalysts. The company also engages in the collection, transportation, and intermediate processing of industrial waste, as well as provides digital platform to streamline operations for industrial waste management companies.
